synthesizedFacts.fact: Vitamin C is a potent antioxidant that can protect the skin from free radical damage and UV-induced photodamage.
Topical application of Vitamin C can improve the appearance of wrinkles, dark spots, and overall skin texture.
Vitamin C promotes collagen synthesis, which is crucial for maintaining skin elasticity and reducing signs of aging.
Vitamin C can reduce melanin production, helping to lighten hyperpigmentation and even out skin tone.
The stability and formulation of Vitamin C products are critical for their efficacy on the skin.
